title: Mixed Event — As the Leaves Change Once More — Episode1 An Autumnal Invitation

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More
meta.Event Outline: After the success at Jam Fest, Shiho is energized to practice. But Shizuku and Saki invite her on a day trip to relax and enjoy the fall foliage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Okay, that felt pretty good just now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My fingers are moving well, and I'm maintaining a steady rhythm.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ever since Jam Fest ended, I've been in good form.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (More people than we were expecting ended up listening to our song.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I was thinking about calling it a day, but I wanna keep practicing for a bit longer.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I just finished the second verse, so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The bath is ready, so I came to see if you wanted to go first.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I want to keep practicing, so I'll take mine later.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
Then, I think I'll take mine now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've been practicing late into the night for quite a while now. Please don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh? Yeah, I'll be careful.
Thanks, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I think I stayed up too late again last night. I still feel kinda sleepy...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I should end practice early today and...)

Oh, Shiho, there you are!
Hey, I found her!
You did? Thank you for finding her so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki? Shizuku...?
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's something we'd like to discuss with you. That's why we were looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've got a bad feeling about this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
We've actually got some wonderful news that's sure to excite you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, fine... So, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How would you feel about us taking a day trip together?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we'll travel somewhere a bit out of the way to have delicious food and see beautiful sights! Doesn't that sound wonderful?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wonderful or no...
Why a day trip all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. The thing is, while walking to school earlier...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The leaves are changing color, there's a nice aroma of osmanthus in the air... A lovely autumn day in every respect.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem to have brought a bit of fall with you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
There's a red leaf stuck to your hair.
Just give me a second to get it out...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe it flew over on that breeze just now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Also, this leaf's so pretty!
It really feels like, you know, it's fall!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wouldn't it be wonderful to enjoy the season by going to see the leaves somewhere...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, now that you mention it...
Our family tried to go one time when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We didn't end up going, because it rained that day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa and I frowned out the window all day long.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Something similar actually happened to us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In our case, it began to rain right when we got to the foot of the mountain. Shii and I felt so sad. I vividly remember us holding hands while staring at the rainy mountain.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Is that true?
Hehe. What a coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Since we're on the subject...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, we still have to invite Tsukasa, but the Tenmas and Hinomoris are gonna go leaf-viewing together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because all of us have experienced not getting to see the leaves! So, we're taking another crack at it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I was surprised to hear that both our families experienced something extremely similar. I get why you'd want to go...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But do any of us have time to take a trip right now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Urgh... But Jam Fest is over, so we have a little time on our hands...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I believe it's important to take breaks from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Please, Shiho!
I know it'll be fun if all four of us go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I would love to go on a trip with you, too. It's been so long, Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (To be fair, ever since Shizuku became an idol, we haven't really been able to go on trips as a family...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I also felt really sad about not being able to see the leaves back then...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes!
All systems are go for the Tenma-Hinomori Leaf-Viewing Reattempt!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, but you two will need to come up with the itinerary and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we'll take care of all that, while making sure we don't interfere with your practice schedule.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna tell Tsukasa about this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait for our trip!
